securityDefinerTriggers.reason: This existing BEFORE INSERT trigger on kernel_private.execution_bindings performs a real UPDATE of kernel_private.release_epoch (epoch = epoch) to lock it and stamp the binding. As SECURITY INVOKER it would force both runtime roles to hold UPDATE on release_epoch, which section 27.3 forbids. As SECURITY DEFINER it does exactly the same work with the owner's rights and the roles hold nothing on the table. The body is unchanged, it already sets search_path = '', and a trigger function cannot be called directly. THIS IS A DEVIATION from the letter of section 27.8 ('no trigger changes') and needs an explicit ruling.
